source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Visibility uses **line of sight**: a straight, imaginary line 1 mm wide between any point on the observing model and any point on the observed one, ignoring other models in the 2 models' units. Terrain adds further visibility rules (13.07).

- A model is **visible** if line of sight reaches any part of it.
- It is **fully visible** if line of sight reaches every part of it facing the observer.
- A unit is visible if 1 or more of its models are visible.
- It is fully visible if all its models are, seeing through the unit's other models.

When a rule calls for a visible unit without saying to whom, visibility is checked from the unit using the rule.
